P.name: Gift of the Drowned Ones
P.title: Template:Data Pyke/Gift of the Drowned Ones
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Gift of the Drowned Ones|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Pyke
|skill        = I
|icon         = false
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Pyke}} gains {{as|{{sti|ad|attack damage}}}} equal to a portion of his {{as|{{sti|health|bonus health}}}}.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Pyke''' stores [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] when receiving damage from enemy {{tip|champions}}, increased if there are multiple nearby. 
|blurb3       = '''Pyke''' can {{tip|heal}} himself by consuming grey health while hidden.
|blurb4       = '''Pyke's''' {{sti|health|{{as|maximum health}}}} cannot increase except by {{sti|xp|leveling}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Pyke's''' {{sti|health|{{as|'''maximum''' health}}}} cannot increase except through [[Growth#Increasing_Statistics|growth (per level)]], instead he gains{{ft|{{sti|{{as|1 '''bonus''' attack damage}}}} {{as|per 14 '''bonus''' health}}.|{{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to {{as|{{fd|7.143}}% of '''bonus''' health}}.}}
|description2 = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Pyke''' gains {{as|1 '''bonus''' movement speed}} while in the river.
|icon3        = Gift of the Drowned Ones.png
|description3 = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Pyke''' stores 9% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.2}}% per 1 Lethality)}} of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he takes from enemy {{tip|champions}} as [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] on his [[health bar]], increased to 40% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.4}}% per 1 Lethality)}} while there are two or more {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champions nearby. He can store up to 80 {{as|(+ 800% '''bonus''' AD)}} [[Health#Grey health|grey health]], with an upper cap of {{as|55% of his '''maximum''' health}}.
|description4 = While '''Pyke''' is not {{tip|sight|visible}} to enemies, he rapidly consumes his [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] to {{tip|heal}} for the same amount.
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 1500
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|damagetype   = 
|spellshield  = 
|spelleffects = 
|occurrence   = 
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|parry        = 
|notes        =
* Game elements that increase health based on the champion's health (e.g {{ri|Overgrowth}}) will increase the health before getting converted by ''Gift of the Drowned Ones'', thus granting increased {{as|bonus AD}}.
* Pyke converts {{as|bonus health}} to {{as|bonus AD}} at a gold efficiency of {{fd|93.75}}%.
* {{ii|Spirit Visage}} and {{tip|Grievous Wounds}} take effect after ''Gift of the Drowned Ones's'' healing cap.
*'''Pyke's''' ''grey health'' does not have a time limit, and will stay on his {{as|health bar}} until '''Pyke''' leaves enemy vision or dies.
** However, if his combined {{as|'''current''' health}} and ''grey health'' would start to exceed {{as|100% of his '''maximum''' health}}, the excess ''grey health'' is lost.
* Since '''Pyke's''' '''maximum''' health cannot be increased, ''Gift of the Drowned Ones'' reaches the upper cap of {{as|55% of '''maximum''' health}} at {{pp|(0.6*({{ccd|Pyke|hp_base}}+{{ccd|Pyke|hp_lvl}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)))-80)/8 for 20|color=ad}} {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}.
* {{tip|Untargetable}} champions count towards '''Pyke's''' modified ''grey health'' storing.
* Amount of attack damage granted from list of items that grants health, converted with ''Gift of the Drowned Ones'':
{{Item stat table|pykehealth}}
|yvideo       = gJ2b3PNxfEg
}}

W.name: Ghostwater Dive
W.title: Template:Data Pyke/Ghostwater Dive
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Ghostwater Dive|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Pyke
|skill        = W
|icon         = Ghostwater Dive.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Pyke}} submerges into water, entering {{tip|camouflage}} and gaining a burst of {{as|{{sti|movement speed}}}} for a few seconds. Nearby enemies are alerted of his presence.
|blurb2      = Attacking or casting abilities ends ''Ghostwater Dive'' immediately.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pyke''' submerges into water for 5 seconds, entering {{tip|camouflage}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|45%|ms}} {{as|(+ 2% per 1 Lethality)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over the duration. Attacking or casting abilities ends ''Ghostwater Dive'' immediately.
|description2 = ''Enemy champions within 1500 units of '''Pyke''' are alerted of his presence and whether he can execute them with {{ai|Death from Below|Pyke}}.''
|customlabel  = Detection Radius
|custominfo   = 600
|cost         = 65
|costtype     = Mana
|cooldown     = {{ap|14 to 10}}
|targeting    = Auto
|cast time    = none
|queue time   = {{fd|0.275}}
|affects      = Self
|damagetype   = 
|spellshield  = 
|spelleffects = 
|occurrence   = 
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|parry        = 
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Pyke Original W SFX 0.ogg}} ''Dive alert.'' {{sm2|Pyke Original W SFX 1.ogg}} ''Execute alert.''
|notes        = 
* When an enemy is alerted, sharks will circle underneath their feet while a sound will be played to them that changes based on health threshold.
* Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup.
* {{pending for test}} While submerged, a unique visual indicator will appear above '''Pyke''' if there are enemy champions closer than 700 units but farther than 600 units.
|yvideo       = Fvey4-tzHos
}}

E.name: Phantom Undertow
E.title: Template:Data Pyke/Phantom Undertow
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Phantom Undertow|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Pyke
|skill        = E
|icon         = Phantom Undertow.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Pyke}} dashes in the target direction, leaving behind a phantom and becoming {{tip|ghosted}}.
|blurb2      = After a brief period, the phantom homes back to '''Pyke''' to briefly {{tip|stun}} enemies it passes through. Enemy {{tip|champions}} hit also take {{as|physical damage}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pyke''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction, leaving behind a ''Phantom''. '''Pyke''' is {{tip|ghosted}} while the ''Phantom'' is active.
|description2 = After 1 second, the ''Phantom'' homes back to '''Pyke''' to {{tip|stun}} enemies around it and those it passes through along the way for {{fd|1.25}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.1}} per 10 Lethality)}} seconds. Enemy champions hit also take {{as|physical damage}}.
|leveling2    = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|100 to 300}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|target range = 550
|effect radius= {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|110|Phantom unit checking for nearby units}}
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|220|Phantom tracking missile}}
|speed        = {{tt|3000|Both dash and returning phantom's missile speed}}
|cast time    = none
|cost         = 40
|costtype     = Mana
|cooldown     = {{ap|15 to 11}}
|queue time   = {{fd|0.275}}
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|occurrence   = 
|projectile   = true
|grounded     = true
|knockdown    = true
|parry        = 
|terraingrace = true
|notes        =
* The {{tip|dash}} distance can be extended to up to 900 units (estimated) when targeting across terrain.
* Like most [[missiles|projectiles]], the flying ''Phantom'' cannot hit targets whose {{tip|center range|center}} is behind the position it originates at or beyond the position it catches up to '''Pyke''' at, but the spell ''can'' hit targets behind its origin as long as their {{tip|edge range|hitbox radius}} overlaps with the original unit ''Phantom's'' 110-radius check at the end of its lifespan.
|yvideo       = sdNfoO-JXak
}}

R.name: Death from Below
R.title: Template:Data Pyke/Death from Below
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Death from Below|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Pyke
|skill        = R
|icon         = Death from Below.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Pyke}} strikes the target location in a X pattern, which {{tip|execute|executes}} enemy {{tip|champions}} hit that are {{as|at low health}}. Other enemies hit are instead dealt {{as|physical damage}}.
|blurb2      = If ''Death from Below'' hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}, '''Pyke''' will {{tip|blink}} to the location. If an enemy champion dies inside the X, ''Death from Below'' can be recast within a period of time at no cost.
|blurb3      = Each execution grants {{g|kill gold}} to both '''Pyke''' and the last assisting ally instead of the natural assist gold.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pyke''' marks the target location with the shape of an ''X'' before striking it, {{tip|execute|executing}} enemy {{tip|champions}} within the area that are below {{as|{{pp|250;290;330;370;400;430;450;470;490;510;530;540;550|6 to 18}}|health}} {{as|(+ 80% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}} per 1 Lethality)}} {{sti|{{as|health}}}}. Other enemies hit and enemy champions above the threshold are instead dealt{{ft|50% of the amount as {{as|physical damage}}.|{{as|{{pp|125;145;165;185;200;215;225;235;245;255;265;270;275|6 to 18}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.75}} per 1 Lethality)}} {{as|physical damage}}.}}
|icon3        = Death from Below 2.png
|description2 = If ''Death from Below'' hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} or at least one is [[death|killed]] inside the ''X'' by the ''execution'' or an ally, '''Pyke''' will {{tip|blink}} to the center of the ''X''. For the latter case '''Pyke''' can also recast the ability within 20 seconds at no cost.
|description3 = Each successful ''execution'' grants one ''{{ii|Your Cut}}'' to the last assisting ally, instead of its natural [[assist]] {{g|gold}}. Otherwise, '''Pyke''' is granted a ''{{ii|Your Cut}}'' for each enemy champion killed inside the ''X'' by an ally during ''Death from Below's'' cast time.
|cooldown     = {{ap|100 to 70}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = mana
|target range = 750
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|125|Circle check in the center}}|{{tt|{{fd|282.5}}{{times}}100|Arms length x width, Direction of arms 45° off the coordinate axes}}}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.5}}
|queue time   = {{fd|0.25}}
|targeting    = Location
|damagetype   = Physical True
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = special
|occurrence   = 
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = true
|parry        = 
|callforhelp  = special
|outofrange   = walk to location
|notes        = 
* Applies {{tip|raw damage}} to executed targets and {{tip|area damage}} to targets above the threshold.
* ''Death from Below's'' execute against an enemy champion will aggro nearby enemy minions.
* ''Death from Below'' cannot execute {{tip|clone|clones}}. They are always dealt 50% {{as|physical damage}}.
* If the target is in a {{tip|zombie state}}, does not enter the {{tip|death}} state, or is killed by the ability while ''above'' the execution threshold, ''Death from Below'' does not grant {{ii|Your Cut}} nor the recast.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} does not prevent '''Pyke''' from {{tip|blink|blinking}}.
* ''Death from Below'' cannot be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}; '''Pyke''' will always appear at the target location if enemy champions are caught inside the ''X'' even if he is moved (e.g. by being {{tip|airborne|displaced}}) during the cast time.
** The only exception is if he is being {{tip|suppression|suppressed}}, in which case he will not {{tip|blink}}.
* {{ri|Axiom Arcanist}} does not refund the cooldown while '''Pyke''' is able to recast.{{bug|2}}
** {{ri|Axiom Arcanist|Axiom Arcanist's}} tooltip counts it refunding ''Death from Below'' even when it doesn't.{{bug}}
* ''Death from Below'' will not go on cooldown if '''Pyke''' dies during its cast.
** '''Pyke''' will still generate {{ii|Your Cut}} from enemies that die inside the ''X'' before '''Pyke''' dies.
|yvideo       = Nur4IJq-wCY
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Pyke_Original_RExecuteEnemy_4.ogg}} ''"Sink with me..."''
}}
